events.description: Initialization of the diffraction grating point sources and the LightWaveSlice overlay.
events.clip_query: A set of point sources representing a diffraction grating appears on screen with a wave slice overlay.

events.description: Continuous propagation of waves from the point sources, showing interference fringes.
events.clip_query: Waves propagate outwards from multiple point sources, creating an interference pattern.

events.description: Modification of wave parameters such as frequency or wave number, altering the fringe spacing.
events.clip_query: The wave interference pattern changes spacing as frequency or wavelength is adjusted.

events.description: Toggling the wave visualization to show intensity instead of raw amplitude.
events.clip_query: The wave pattern transitions to show intensity, highlighting bright and dark bands.
